description: Reserved - Department of Fiscal Policy - Final Budget Position Report issued under section 13 of the Fiscal  Management (Responsibility) Act No. 30 of  2003
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the publication and availability of the Final Budget Position Report (Annual Report of the Ministry of Finance) issued under the Fiscal Management (Responsibility) Act, No. 3 of 2003. The core content pertains to a legal/regulatory requirement for reporting on fiscal management, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5). While it involves a government ministry, the primary focus is on the statutory instrument and compliance with a specific law, not on government personnel changes, structural reorganization, or detailed portfolio assignments.
